title: Sandustry Release Date — Early Access August 13, 2026
description: Sandustry Early Access date, planned EA window, and where to follow updates from Lantto Games and Hooded Horse.

paragraphs: Sandustry entered Steam Early Access on August 13, 2026.
The store page has noted a planned Early Access period on the order of about one year, with more buildings, resources, production chains, quests, and technologies planned.
Follow Steam news on the main app page, the official Discord, Reddit r/SandustryGame, YouTube @sandustry, and the official wiki hosted with Hooded Horse.
Fan sites (including this one) lag patches. Prefer primary sources for unlock tables and balance.
No separate full 1.0 date is treated as locked here beyond the EA window language on Steam.
Revisit the store page and developer posts for leaving-Early-Access announcements.

faq.a: As of this page's research date, it is sold as Steam Early Access, not a finished 1.0 product.
